# Paths
```{r}
id_path   <- "~/GC/Proteome/Pipeline/02.sage/Proteome/results.sage.tsv"
quant_path<- "~/GC/Proteome/Pipeline/02.sage/Proteome/tmt.tsv"
```

# Load identifications & quant
# Drop decoys/condtaminations
```{r}
# Load tables
# NOTE: Large TSVs can take a while to load on first run. 
id_tbl    <- read.delim(id_path,    sep = "\t")
quant_tbl <- read.delim(quant_path, sep = "\t")

# Flags for decoy/contaminant proteins
is_decoy  <- grepl("^rev_", id_tbl$proteins)
is_contam <- grepl("contam_|CON_|cont_", id_tbl$proteins, ignore.case = TRUE)

# Keep only target, non-contaminant entries
keep_idx  <- !(is_decoy | is_contam)
id_tbl_f  <- id_tbl[keep_idx, ]

# Remove corresponding scans from quant table (join by filename + scannr)
to_drop <- id_tbl[!keep_idx, c("filename","scannr")]
quant_tbl_f <- quant_tbl %>% anti_join(to_drop, by = c("filename","scannr"))
```

# Build QFeatures per file and process
# Filter -> log -> normalize -> aggregate to proteins
```{r}
# Create a multi-assay QFeatures split by raw file; TMT columns start with 'user_'
qf <- sageQFeatures(
  quantTable   = quant_tbl_f,
  idTable      = id_tbl_f,
  byQuant      = c("filename","scannr"),
  splitBy      = "filename",
  quantPattern = "user_"
)

# Process a single-sample QFeatures:
# - keep high-confidence PSMs (label>0, rank==1, q<0.01 at spectrum/peptide/protein)
# - set zeros to NA, log-transform, quantile-normalize
# - aggregate to protein using column medians
process_one <- function(qf_one) {
  qf_one %>%
    filterFeatures(~ label > 0) %>%
    filterFeatures(~ rank == 1) %>%
    filterFeatures(~ spectrum_q < 0.01) %>%
    filterFeatures(~ peptide_q  < 0.01) %>%
    filterFeatures(~ protein_q  < 0.01) %>%
    zeroIsNA(i = 1) %>%
    logTransform(i = 1, name = "log_sage") %>%
    normalize(i = "log_sage", name = "norm_sage", method = "quantiles") %>%
    aggregateFeatures(
      i     = "norm_sage",
      name  = "proteins",
      fcol  = "proteins",
      fun   = matrixStats::colMedians,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
}

# Apply to every split (each 'filename')
qf_list <- setNames(
  map(names(qf), function(nm) process_one(QFeatures(list(a1 = qf[[nm]])))),
  names(qf)
)
```

# QC heatmapsl; channel coreelations (PSM-normalize vs protein-aggregated)
```{r}
plot_corr_heatmap <- function(se, title_prefix = "") {
  mat <- assay(se)
  # Keep only channel suffix (remove file prefix if present)
  colnames(mat) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(mat))
  cm  <- round(cor(mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson"), 3)
  dd  <- melt(cm)
  ggplot(dd, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
                         midpoint = 0.6, limits = c(0,1), name = "Pearson") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    labs(title = paste0(title_prefix, " channel correlation"),
         x = NULL, y = NULL)
}

# Draw both levels per sample
invisible(lapply(names(qf_list), function(s){
  g1 <- plot_corr_heatmap(qf_list[[s]][["norm_sage"]], paste0(s, " (PSM norm)"))
  g2 <- plot_corr_heatmap(qf_list[[s]][["proteins"]], paste0(s, " (Protein agg)"))
  grid.arrange(g1, g2, ncol = 2)
}))
```
